subject: LOCK MODE clause
notes: cite.py --check 12.4.5.9.4 8) 'The setting of a record lock is part of the operation of an I-O statement.' OK. Every acquisition happens inside the governed verb's own runtime entry (ReadShared/ReadKeyedShared -> ApplyPostReadLockActions; WriteShared/RewriteShared wantLock -> LockRecord), with no separate lock step emitted around the statement. A failure to set a lock (53/54 ceiling) is therefore the statement's own unsuccessful I-O status, pre-flighted before the operation commits (PB338 landed, PreflightReadLock/PreflightNewLock). Probe rt1 C2 shows the READ itself returning '54'. No existing test is aimed at GR8 specifically, so test-ref is empty. [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (the clause is absent from ISO 1989:1985; it arrives with the 2002 file sharing / record locking facility, D.2.4 / A.4.7; no later change to 12.4.5.9 located)]
